item.title: Mikrotik
item.description:
The Terraform package prepares owner-local DNS management. Router exports remain documentation inputs and are not applied by that package.

Deployment

  • Open Winbox
  • Open new terminal
  • Run /export
  • Copy output

Links

  • Website: https://mikrotik.com
  • Docs: https://help.mikrotik.com/docs/spaces/ROS/pages/328155/Configuration+Management
